lines.text: This shrimp punches so fast, the water around it briefly boils.

parts.tts: This shrimp punches so fast, the water around it briefly boils.
parts.heard: This shrimp punches so fast, the water around it briefly boils.

lines.text: Meet the peacock mantis shrimp. Small, but it hits with thousands of times its body weight.

parts.tts: Meet the peacock mantis shrimp. Small, but it hits with thousands of times its body weight.
parts.heard: Meet the peacock mantis shrimp. Small, but it hits with thousands of times its body weight.

lines.text: Its club fires at 83 kilometers per hour.

parts.tts: Its club fires at eighty-three kilometers per hour.
parts.heard: Its club fires at 83 kilometers per hour.

lines.text: Scientists compare it to a bullet fired from a handgun.

parts.tts: Scientists compare it to a bullet fired from a handgun.
parts.heard: Scientists compare it to a bullet fired from a handgun.

lines.text: But here's the weird part. The strike is so fast, the pressure around it crashes.

parts.tts: But here's the weird part. The strike is so fast, the pressure around it crashes.
parts.heard: But here's the weird part. The strike is so fast, the pressure around it crashes.

lines.text: The water turns into vapor bubbles. Like boiling, but from pressure, not heat.

parts.tts: The water turns into vapor bubbles. Like boiling, but from pressure, not heat.
parts.heard: The water turns into vapor bubbles, like boiling, but from pressure, not heat.

lines.text: Then the bubbles collapse... and hit the target a second time. One punch, two hits.

parts.tts: and hit the target a second time. One punch, two hits.
parts.heard: and hit the target a second time. One punch, two hits.

lines.text: But it gets stranger. The collapsing bubbles give off a tiny flash of light.

parts.tts: But it gets stranger. The collapsing bubbles give off a tiny flash of light.
parts.heard: but it gets stranger. The collapsing bubbles give off a tiny flash of light.

lines.text: Snail shells crack like eggs. And the biggest ones can even break aquarium glass.

parts.tts: Snail shells crack like eggs. And the biggest ones can even break aquarium glass.
parts.heard: Snail shells crack like eggs, and the biggest ones can even break aquarium glass.

lines.text: So whatever you do... never tap on its tank.
